ResearchTabDef.label: artificer
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: The trades the Society keeps behind its own doors. Polyenne weaving, pulse containment, and the armor that makes a single person a siege engine.\n\nEvery one of these was worked out by Oranges, and none of them are credited to any.

ResearchProjectDef.label: polyenne weaving
ResearchProjectDef.description: Draw polyenne into a fiber that holds an edge harder than diamond and remembers two shapes - rigid, and not. The weave is the whole difficulty; the metallurgy is centuries old.\n\nUnlocks the razor.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pulse physics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Confine a charge long enough to throw it. Pulse energy is trivial to generate and miserable to contain, and the entire discipline is the containment.\n\nUnlocks the pulseFist.

ResearchProjectDef.label: recoil plating
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Interlocking plates that coil closed around the body, and around a wound. The trick is not the alloy, which is ordinary; it is the linkage, and the chemistry that fires a clamp and a dose of painkiller without a single circuit to be knocked out.
Unlocks recoilArmor.

ResearchProjectDef.label: pulse armor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Recoil plating, servo assistance, and a shield generator carried on the back. The suit multiplies the wearer rather than merely protecting them, which is why the Society is careful about who is allowed inside one.\n\nIt drinks power. That has never been considered a flaw by anyone who could afford it.

ResearchProjectDef.label: neural interface
ResearchProjectDef.description: The lattice a Blue wears to fly and a Green wears to work. It is grown into the scalp rather than fitted, and the tattooed contacts on a shaved head are the visible half of a much deeper installation.\n\nUnlocks the synaptic lattice implant.

ResearchProjectDef.label: optical camouflage
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Polyenne woven with a refractive lattice, driven hard enough to bend what falls on it. The cloth does not turn the wearer invisible so much as make looking at them exhausting, and the eye gives up before the mind notices it has.
It cannot be run continuously. The lattice sheds heat it cannot lose fast enough, so the field comes in bursts with a long wait between them.
Unlocks the ghostCloak.
